title: CLaS-Bench: A Cross-Lingual Alignment and Steering Benchmark
reasoning: The benchmark evaluates the success of cross-lingual steering techniques in Large Language Models. While its evaluation data includes an 'Opinion' category with some prompts that touch on moral dilemmas (e.g., obligations regarding space exploration), the core metrics (Language Forcing Success and Output Relevance) evaluate language control and semantic coherence rather than benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical frameworks.
